title: Lighthouse ad-hoc flags & owner rollup
content:
Quick ledger for small cross-functional asks — meant to be a lightweight single-pane rollup for on-call, product ops, and SEs. Patchy notes okay. Update in place, add new rows at bottom.

GUIDELINES:
- Use short IDs (F1...) for easy reference in Slack.
- Estimate is ballpark hours for initial triage + owner follow-up. If > 8h mark as "investigate" and ping PG.
- Priority: P1 (urgent customer-facing), P2 (high), P3 (low).
- Last column: suggested next step (who to ping / ticket to open).

FLAG LIST (columns: id | short title | owner | primary contact | est effort | priority | status | notes | suggested next step / ticket)

F1 | intl-region-fallback | Owen Patel | owen@redwood.ai | 4h | P2 | monitoring | observed increased fallback rate for eu-west on 2026-11-01 (spike ~6%) — likely routing config | confirm routing policy + tag endpoints; link JIRA-8472

F2 | embeddings-cache-stale | Sara Alvarez | sara@redwood.ai | 6h | P2 | in-progress | prefix cache invalidation not firing for model:rw-embed-v2 when name changed in deploy; customers reported duplicate encode cost | run repro, add short-lived cache key, open followup PR CONFL-2389

F3 | demo-tenant-ratecap | Jon Kim | jon@redwood.ai | 2h | P3 | todo | internal demo tenant throttled unexpectedly during demo on 2026-11-01 | increase soft quota, monitor for 24h

F4 | private-deploy-doc-gap | Maya Chen | maya@redwood.ai | 3h | P3 | todo | missing step in onboarding doc for KMS rotation in vpc-private package | draft doc snippet and drop into Confluence; ping infra docs owner

F5 | rollback-telemetry-handoff | Owen Patel | owen@redwood.ai | 5h | P2 | investigating | telemetry shows missing spans after a canary rollback; affects per-route latency dashboards | capture traces for last 3 canaries, correlate with PR #1294

F6 | billing-estimate-outlier | Finance (TBD) | finance@redwood.ai | 4h | P2 | monitoring | one customer reported 2x token billing discrepancy for embeddings; likely path-mapping error | triage with billing & SE; open invoice hold if confirmed

F7 | routing-nonprod-tagging | Sara Alvarez | sara@redwood.ai | 2h | P3 | todo | nonprod routes occasionally hit prod bucket during burst tests | add explicit nonprod tag, coordinate with release-eng

F8 | model-catalog-mismatch | Jon Kim | jon@redwood.ai | 3h | P3 | todo | model alias mismatch between hosted catalog and deploy manifest (rw-chat vs rw-chat-stable) | reconcile aliases + add guard in onboarding

F9 | se-oncall-handbook-update | Maya Chen | maya@redwood.ai | 1h | P3 | todo | small clarifications for SE playbook (who to loop for dedicated contracts) | PR to handbook repo

F10 | quick-eval-regression | Owen Patel | owen@redwood.ai | 8h | P1 | investigate | sudden regression on rouge metric for rw-summarize in prod sample set; customer-facing | block rollout, run full eval harness, assign eng-alert

HOW TO USE THIS LEDGER:
- If you take ownership, update the "owner" field and change status to in-progress. Drop one-line updates at top of row.
- If you escalate, add JIRA or GH link in suggested next step.
- For anything marked P1, @#oncall-sre and #product-ops in Slack immediately.

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs:
- Confirm finance owner for F6 (assign by 2026-11-06).
- Add a tiny script to export rows to a shared spreadsheet for macros/filters (low priority).
- Decide cadence: weekly scrub with product-ops or asynchronous updates? put on Friday 10am sync if we want cadence.

NOTES TO SELF (choppy):
- this is intentionally lightweight. avoid over-structuring.
- if any row hits > 16h, move to formal ticket backlog and remove from this ledger (keep reference).
- keep email aliases short (use first names internally).

END.
